# Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the main files touched.

# Checklist

- [ ] Mathematical correctness is justified for any new algorithm, transform, kernel, or stopping logic.
- [ ] Public API compatibility was preserved, or the breaking change is intentional and documented.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, including at least one mathematically meaningful invariant when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation, docstrings, demos, and notebooks were updated if usage or outputs changed.
- [ ] Benchmarks were run or updated for performance-sensitive changes, or I explained why they were not needed.
- [ ] Reproducibility details are recorded: seeds, pinned QMCPy or oracle versions, and exact commands used for benchmark or parity claims.
- [ ] QMCPy parity intent was checked against `sc_notes/qmcpy-parity.md`, and any parity change was documented there.
